reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing the education sector by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly, helping struggling students catch up while challenging advanced learners. Teachers benefit from automated grading and administrative task reduction, allowing them to focus on mentorship. However, concerns about data privacy and the potential loss of human interaction in classrooms remain significant challenges that educators must address carefully.

questions.q: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as a benefit of AI in education?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 AI의 교육적 이점으로 개인화된 학습, 자동 채점, 교사의 행정업무 감소가 언급되었습니다. 하지만 학생 등록금 증가는 언급되지 않았으므로 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What can AI systems do based on individual learning patterns?
options: Adapt content to meet student needs
questions.explanation: 지문의 두 번째 문장에서 'AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned regarding AI in education?
options: AI is too expensive to implement
Data privacy and loss of human interaction
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 'concerns about data privacy and the potential loss of human interaction in classrooms'이 주요 우려사항으로 언급되었습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made our lives better rather than more complicated'? Use specific examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 의견을 명확히 제시하고 2-3개의 주요 근거를 미리 언급합니다. 예: 'I strongly agree that technology has improved our daily lives in several important ways.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 논거로 의료 기술의 발전과 건강 개선을 다룹니다. 구체적인 예시(원격진료, 진단기술 향상)를 포함하세요.
structure.body2: 두 번째 논거로 통신 기술이 인간관계를 어떻게 개선했는지 설명합니다. 장거리 가족 연락, 글로벌 협업의 예시를 제시하세요.
structure.conclusion: 주요 요점들을 요약하고 최종 의견을 재확인합니다. 미래 전망이나 광범위한 영향력으로 마무리하세요.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer studying alone, while others prefer studying in groups. Which study method do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in groups because...
One reason is that group study helps me understand difficult concepts better.
Another advantage is that I can learn from my peers' perspectives and insights.
sample_points: 그룹 스터디에서 다양한 관점을 배울 수 있고, 어려운 개념을 함께 논의하며 해결할 수 있습니다.
동료들과 공부하면서 동기부여가 되고, 설명하는 과정에서 자신의 이해도를 확인할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: Career Planning Meeting
listening.script: Student: Professor Chen, I'm trying to decide between pursuing a career in environmental science or technology. I'm really interested in both fields. Professor Chen: That's wonderful, but let me ask you this: what specifically attracts you to each field? Student: Well, environmental science appeals to me because I want to help solve climate problems. But technology interests me because of the innovation and problem-solving aspects. Professor Chen: Here's my suggestion: you don't have to choose one forever. Many professionals today work at the intersection of both fields. For example, you could develop green technology solutions. Have you considered that possibility? Student: That's actually a great idea! I hadn't thought about combining them. Professor Chen: Many of the most exciting careers today are interdisciplinary. You might research renewable energy systems or develop software for environmental monitoring. This way, you address your passion for the environment while using technological innovation.

questions.q: What are the two career fields the student is considering?
questions.explanation: 대화의 첫 부분에서 학생이 '환경 과학(environmental science)과 기술(technology) 중에 선택해야 한다'고 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What suggestion does Professor Chen make?
options: Combine both fields through interdisciplinary work
Wait a few years before deciding
questions.explanation: 교수는 '두 분야 중 하나를 선택할 필요가 없다'고 말하고 '두 분야의 교차점에서 일하는 것'을 제안했습니다. 녹색 기술 개발이 그 예시입니다.

questions.q: What examples does the professor give of combined career paths?
options: Renewable energy systems and environmental monitoring software
questions.explanation: 교수는 '재생에너지 시스템 연구' 또는 '환경 모니터링 소프트웨어 개발'을 구체적인 예시로 제시했습니다.
